Description.SourceString: Next time you find a greater kalphite wing, open it out to its full length and hold it up to the light. It's a wondrous sight, like a mixture of oil slick and flickering flame, which would be unwise to combine anywhere else. Its beauty, of course, has made it a desirable trading material, and is used by the Moon Garou in dream-catchers, mobiles for younger garou, and - of course - infinity cloth.
